operations.name: read_device_control
operations.desc: Read the Device Control register to get hardware state and capabilities
operations.returns: 32-bit control register value containing FD, LRST, ASDE, SLU bits

operations.name: read_device_status
operations.desc: Read the Device Status register for link state and speed information
operations.returns: 32-bit status register with FD, LU, TXOFF, SPEED bits

operations.name: read_interrupt_cause
operations.desc: Read the Interrupt Cause register to check pending interrupts
operations.returns: 32-bit value with TXDW, TXQE, LSC, RXSEQ, RXDMT0, RXO, RXT0, MDAC, RXCFG, PHYINT, GPI bits

operations.name: read_rx_control
operations.desc: Read the Receive Control register for RX configuration
operations.returns: 32-bit RX control with EN, SBP, UPE, MPE, LPE, LBM, RDMTS, MO, SZ, SECRC, DTYP bits

operations.name: read_tx_control
operations.desc: Read the Transmit Control register for TX configuration
operations.returns: 32-bit TX control with EN, PSP, CT, COLD, SWXP, PXE bits

operations.name: read_rx_desc_base
operations.desc: Read the RX Descriptor Base Address Low register
operations.returns: 32-bit lower address of RX descriptor ring

operations.name: read_rx_desc_length
operations.desc: Read the RX Descriptor Length register
operations.returns: 32-bit value with descriptor ring size in bytes

operations.name: read_rx_desc_head
operations.desc: Read the RX Descriptor Head pointer
operations.returns: 32-bit head pointer index into RX descriptor ring

operations.name: read_rx_desc_tail
operations.desc: Read the RX Descriptor Tail pointer
operations.returns: 32-bit tail pointer index into RX descriptor ring

operations.name: read_tx_desc_base
operations.desc: Read the TX Descriptor Base Address Low register
operations.returns: 32-bit lower address of TX descriptor ring

operations.name: read_tx_desc_length
operations.desc: Read the TX Descriptor Length register
operations.returns: 32-bit value with descriptor ring size in bytes

operations.name: read_tx_desc_head
operations.desc: Read the TX Descriptor Head pointer
operations.returns: 32-bit head pointer index into TX descriptor ring

operations.name: read_tx_desc_tail
operations.desc: Read the TX Descriptor Tail pointer
operations.returns: 32-bit tail pointer index into TX descriptor ring

operations.name: read_statistics_crcerrs
operations.desc: Read CRC Errors counter from statistics
